ArcSense.description: Clockwise or counter-clockwise when looking along the plane normal (+Z for XY, +Y for ZX, +X for YZ).

anyOf.description: The same events a tool-space path can carry.

AxisIndex.description: Zero-based index of an axis past the nine letters. Valid values are `9..MAX_AXES`.

oneOf.description: Radians about the kinematic direction, right-handed.

AxisLetter.description: X Y Z A B C U V W, in that order. Further axes use an index.

AxisLimits.description: Inclusive travel limits. Millimetres when linear, radians when rotary.

AxisMotion.description: Axis-space motion. Targets are joint values at the end of the move.

oneOf.description: Arc expressed in the machine base frame, with joint values at the end.

center.description: Arc centre in the base frame, millimetres.

oneOf.description: Helix in the machine base frame, with joint values at the end.

center.description: A point on the helix axis, millimetres.

anyOf.description: One of X Y Z A B C U V W.
Indexed extra. The index is the zero-based ordinal, from 9 upward.

AxisName.description: Letter or index that names an axis.

AxisTarget.description: One joint position at the end of an axis-space move.

value.description: Millimetres or radians, matching the axis kind.

Carrier.description: Which slide carries a rotary joint.

oneOf.description: The joint moves the work. Its pivot is in machine coordinates at zero angles.
The joint moves the tool. Its pivot is relative to the gauge point at zero head angles.

Channel.description: A group of axes that move together: one head, spindle or turret.

anyOf.description: Process, dwell, tool change or other event.

ClBlock.description: One tool-space step: a motion or an event.

ClMotion.description: Tool-space motion. `feed` is millimetres per minute. Rapid feed is `None` for a machine rapid.

oneOf.description: Circular feed of at most one full turn. The sense and the endpoints pick the sweep.
Circular feed plus travel along the plane normal. `sweep` is radians and may exceed one turn.

center.description: A point on the helix axis, millimetres.

sweep.description: Absolute sweep in radians. One full turn is `2π`.

oneOf.description: Spindle-synchronised straight feed (single-point threading). `lead` is millimetres per spindle revolution. Turning programs only.

ClPath.description: A cutter-location path: what an operation produces before kinematics.

continuous.description:
Continuous five-axis motion. False keeps the toolpath on one indexed tool axis.

Omitted on disk when false, so a file written before this flag still loads.

pierce.description: Where the process turns on, when the source operation recorded it.

oneOf.description: The path is already offset by the tool radius or half the kerf.
A later post should keep the tool to the left of travel.
A later post should keep the tool to the right of travel.
Gas or air assist for a laser, plasma or similar process.

Event.description:
One non-motion step.

In a turning program [`Event::CAxis`] engages a spindle as a positioning C axis and
[`Event::SpindleBrake`] clamps that spindle. [`Event::LiveToolOn`] starts the driven tool.
[`Event::FaceInterpolation`] and [`Event::CylinderInterpolation`] select a Cartesian face frame
or an unrolled cylinder frame; both require the C axis to be engaged when a post writes them.
`Pose::rotary` on a motion in that program is the C angle in degrees: finite, absolute value
at most 99999. A live-tool event does not require a turning setup.
[`Event::SpindleOrient`] turns a spindle to an angle in `0..360` degrees. A secondary-spindle
orient is written while that spindle is not selected.
[`Event::ChuckClamp`], [`Event::SpindleSync`], [`Event::SpindleRun`] and [`Event::SpindleMove`]
hand a part between spindles. `SpindleRun` runs a spindle that is not the active binding's spindle.
[`Event::HeadIndex`] sets the named head's B angle. The tool axis of the moves that follow is
`(cos b_deg, 0, sin b_deg)`. [`Event::Tailstock`] advances or retracts the tailstock. Hold
force and travel are machine settings; the event carries no position.
[`Event::SteadyRest`] clamps or unclamps the steady rest. The rest is positioned in setup;
the event carries no position.
[`Event::PartsCatcher`] moves the parts catcher into position to catch a part, or out of the
work envelope. [`Event::BarFeed`] commands a bar feeder. Optional lengths are one-line
overrides in millimetres: part length plus cutoff and facing allowance, and minimum clamping
length.

oneOf.description: Turn a process on. `params` includes pierce and post timing.
Pause, in seconds. The tool does not move.
Select a tool by its id.
Probe. `toward` is the expected contact pose when the path states one.
Human-readable note. Posts may emit it as a comment.
Named extension point. `name` is not a machine code.
Wait until every channel listed on this sync id arrives.
Use the named spindle as a positioning C axis (`engage: true`) or return it to turning (`false`).

engage.description: `true` engages the C axis. `false` returns the spindle to turning.

oneOf.description:
Clamp (`true`) or release (`false`) the named spindle's brake while the C axis holds position.

Spindle `sub` is the secondary caliper brake and does not need a C axis. Any other spindle
must have one.

Orient the named spindle. `angle_deg` is finite and in `0..360`.

The post writes a secondary-spindle orient while that spindle is not selected.

angle_deg.description: Angle in degrees, from 0 inclusive to 360 exclusive.

oneOf.description: Start the live (driven) tool. `rpm` > 0, finite, at most 100000.

Cartesian face interpolation. While on, a pose tip (x, y, z) is a point on the part face
frame: x, y Cartesian about the spindle axis, z axial. Poses carry no rotary. Arcs may use
[`crate::Plane::Xy`].

on.description: `true` selects the face frame. `false` leaves it.

oneOf.description:
Cylinder interpolation. While on (`radius` Some, > 0), tip.x is the radius of the tool tip,
tip.y is the distance unrolled along the circumference at `radius` (C degrees = y / radius
in radians), z axial. Arcs may use [`crate::Plane::Yz`]. `None` turns it off.

radius.description: Mapping radius in millimetres. Absent or `None` leaves cylinder interpolation.

oneOf.description: Clamp (`true`) or unclamp (`false`) the named chuck.

Engage or cancel synchronous spindle control.

`phase_deg` is only allowed when `engage` is true. It is finite and in `0..360`.

phase_deg.description: Phase in degrees. Absent when sync has no phase, and when sync is cancelled.

oneOf.description:
Run or stop a spindle that is not the active binding's spindle.

`rpm` 0 stops the spindle. `reverse` selects the reverse direction when `rpm` is above 0.

rpm.description: Revolutions per minute. Zero stops the spindle.

oneOf.description:
Move a spindle housing along Z.

`feed` absent is a rapid. `machine` selects machine coordinates.

feed.description: Feed, millimetres per minute. Absent is a rapid.

oneOf.description:
Index the named head's B axis, in degrees.

`b_deg` is finite. The tool axis from the tip toward the pivot is `(cos b_deg, 0, sin b_deg)`.

Advance (`engage: true`) or retract (`false`) the lathe tailstock. Hold force and
travel are machine settings; the event carries no position.

Clamp (`clamp: true`) or unclamp (`false`) the lathe steady rest. The rest is
positioned in setup; the event carries no position.

clamp.description: `true` clamps the steady rest. `false` unclamps it.

oneOf.description:
Move the parts catcher into position to catch a part (`extend: true`) or out of the
work envelope (`false`).

extend.description: `true` moves the catcher in to catch a part. `false` moves it out of the work envelope.

oneOf.description:
Bar feed (Haas G105) with optional one-line overrides in millimetres: part length plus
cutoff and facing allowance, and minimum clamping length.

part_length.description: Part length plus cutoff and facing allowance, millimetres.

Feeds.description:
Operation feeds, millimetres per minute.

Each cutting move also stores its own feed. Role-specific fields override `cut` when a path
is converted. `None` means "use `cut`".

FiveAxisSetup.description:
Kinematics and the rule that picks one inverse solution.

Posts run the inverse. The part-frame toolpaths do not store joint angles.

kinematics.description: One or two rotary joints and the spindle direction.

policy.description: How to pick one inverse solution.

Hand.description: Which way the cutting edge faces along the spindle.

oneOf.description: Symmetric insert, such as a groove or a round.

Head.description:
A turret or a tilting B head.

`stations` is the number of tool pockets, from 1 to 256. `live_tooling` is true when the
head can drive a spinning tool. Axes always include X and Z. Y and B are optional. The same
struct is a plain turret today and a Y/B live head later.

HeadAxis.description:
Axis a turning head can carry.

X and Z are required. Y and B are optional, so a later live-tool or tilting B head uses this
same enum.

oneOf.description: Radial axis. Toolpaths store this as a radius.

Insert.description:
One turning insert.

`orientation_deg` is the angle in the XZ plane, in degrees, from +Z toward +X, of the
insert's bisector. The bisector points from the nose into the holder. `hand` records which
way the edge faces; it does not change [`Self::tip_offset`].

nose_radius.description: Nose radius, millimetres. Zero is a sharp corner. A round insert must be greater than zero.

orientation_deg.description: Bisector from the nose into the holder, degrees in the XZ plane, from +Z toward +X.

width.description: Insert width, millimetres. Required for a groove insert. Positive when set.

InsertShape.description: ISO insert shape. The number is the included angle in degrees, when the shape has one.

oneOf.description: Parting or grooving insert. No included angle.

KinematicNode.description:
Where a joint sits on its parent.

`direction` is the positive linear travel, or the rotary axis, in the parent frame.
`offset` is the joint origin relative to the parent origin, in millimetres.
`parent` is `None` when the joint is mounted on the machine base.

Kinematics.description: One or two rotary joints and the spindle direction at zero head angles.

name.description: Non-empty name. It is quoted in validation errors.

rotaries.description: Outer joint first within each [`Carrier`]. One or two entries.

spindle_axis.description: Tool axis at zero head angles. Defaults to +Z. Normalised on load.

oneOf.description: Tool spins in the forward direction.
Tool spins in the reverse direction.

Machine.description: The joints of one machine and the channels that group them.

MoveRole.description: Why a feed move exists. Rapids have no role.

ParamValue.description: A JSON parameter: a bool, a finite number, or text.

Plane.description: Plane of a circular arc or helix, named by its two axes.

oneOf.description: XY, viewed from +Z. The usual flat work plane.

Pose.description:
Tool pose in the part frame.

`tip` is the tool tip. `axis` points from the tip toward the spindle (or along the process
direction). It is stored as given; a unit vector is the convention.

`rotary` is the machine A/B angle in degrees when the program has a [`crate::RotarySetup`].
It may exceed 360 for multi-turn motion. In a turning program it is the C angle in degrees:
finite, and at most 99999 in absolute value. A pose with no rotary angle does not command
that axis.

ProcessKind.description: What a process-on event turns on.

oneOf.description: Any later process. The string is a short name, not a machine id.

ProcessParams.description:
Parameters stored with a process-on event.

Delays are seconds. Heights are absolute Z in millimetres. `pierce_process_on_during_delay`
defaults to true and `post_process_on_during_delay` defaults to false, matching
`campanion_path::ProcessTiming`.

power.description: Process power. The unit depends on the process (watts, a fraction, a current).

speed.description: Spindle revolutions per minute, or a process-defined rate.

ProfileTab.description: One tab left uncut along a profile. Lengths are millimetres along the path. Height is a lift in Z.

Program.description: Tools, machine, toolpaths and channel programs.

five_axis.description: Five-axis kinematics. Absent on a 3-axis or rotary-table program.

max_axis_step_deg.description:
Largest tool-axis change, in degrees, on one feed of a continuous toolpath.

The value is in `(0, 90]`. The default is 5. Omitted on disk when it is the default,
so a file written before this setting still loads.

RotaryAxisKind.description: A or B table axis, named in the part frame.

oneOf.description: Rotation about the part X axis.
Rotation about the part Y axis.

RotaryDirection.description: Sign applied to the machine A/B angle before a right-hand rotation about the axis.

oneOf.description: The machine angle is used as the right-hand rotation angle.
The machine angle is negated before the right-hand rotation.

RotaryJoint.description:
One rotary joint. `letter` is `A`, `B` or `C`.

`axis` is normalised on load. Rotation is right-handed about it. `pivot` is a point on the
axis line. See the module docs for which frame that point is written in.

axis.description: Rotation axis. Stored as a unit vector after [`Kinematics::from_json`].

limits.description: Inclusive travel limits in degrees. Absent means the joint is unlimited.

pivot.description: A point on the axis line. See the module docs for the frame.

RotaryLimits.description:
Inclusive travel limits for a machine A/B angle, in degrees. `min_deg` is strictly less than
`max_deg`. Stored angles may exceed 360; the limits apply to that stored value.

RotarySetup.description:
Fourth-axis table setup in the part frame.

`center` is a point on the rotary axis line, in millimetres. The axis direction is part +X for
[`RotaryAxisKind::A`] and part +Y for [`RotaryAxisKind::B`]. [`RotaryDirection`] is the sign
applied to the machine angle before a right-hand rotation about that direction.

SolutionPolicy.description:
Which inverse solution a five-axis program keeps.

[`Self::choice`] turns the policy into the [`Choice`] [`Kinematics::choose`] takes.

Spindle.description:
One lathe spindle.

`name` is unique on the setup (`main`, and further names such as `sub`). `c_axis` is that spindle's
C axis as a machine axis id, when the machine has one. `work_zero_z` is the work-zero offset
along Z, in millimetres. Stock Z is measured from that zero.

max_rpm.description: Fastest programmed speed, revolutions per minute.

reversed.description: Positive rotation is opposite the default when true.

SpindleSpeed.description:
Spindle speed for a turning pass: constant surface speed, or a direct rpm.

Stored on [`TurnBinding`] when that toolpath names a speed. A binding with no speed leaves
the number to the process-on parameter.

oneOf.description: Constant surface speed. `surface_m_per_min` is metres per minute. `max_rpm` caps the speed.

max_rpm.description: Spindle cap for this pass, revolutions per minute.

oneOf.description: Direct spindle speed, revolutions per minute.

SyncPoint.description: Channels that must arrive together. A sync event waits on this id.

Tool.description: A cutter or a kerf-only process.

kerf.description: Kerf width, millimetres. Set for a process that has no rotating cutter.

TurnBinding.description:
Binds one toolpath to a spindle, a head and a channel.

`toolpath` is an index into [`crate::Program::toolpaths`]. `channel` is a [`crate::Channel`]
id. An M10 binding uses spindle `main`, head `turret1` and channel 0. `speed` is the spindle
speed for that toolpath. Absent means the post uses the process-on speed parameter.

speed.description: Constant surface speed or direct rpm for this toolpath.

TurnInsert.description:
An insert mounted on a head station.

`live` is true for a driven tool. The head named here must then have [`Head::live_tooling`].
`station` is a pocket number from 1 through the head's station count.

TurnSection.description:
Finished part half-profile, stored for preview and for insert and holder checks.

`points` is a polyline of `(z, radius)` in millimetres, ordered from the front (the end
toward the tailstock, larger Z) toward the chuck. The radius is never negative. The
polyline is the finished surface. It is not stock, and it does not add a leg down to the
axis unless the caller included one.

TurnStock.description:
Bar or tube blank.

The stock occupies Z in `[-length, 0]` relative to the spindle work zero. Z = 0 is the
finished front face, the face toward the tailstock. The chuck is toward -Z. Diameters are
millimetres. Facing stock allowance is not stored here; an operation supplies it.

X toolpaths use radii ([`Self::outer_radius`], [`Self::inner_radius`]), not these diameters.

length.description: Blank length, millimetres. The blank occupies Z in `[-length, 0]`.

oneOf.description: Tube. Diameters and `length` are millimetres. The inner diameter is less than the outer.

inner_diameter.description: Hole diameter, millimetres. Must be less than `outer_diameter`.

length.description: Blank length, millimetres. The blank occupies Z in `[-length, 0]`.

TurningSetup.description:
Spindles, heads, stock, inserts and the toolpath bindings for one lathe program.

`diameter_mode` is only a hint for posts. When true, a post may write X as a diameter.
Toolpath X stays a radius either way. The default hint is true. There are 1 to 4 spindles
and 1 to 8 heads, so a sub-spindle or a second head does not need a new type.
[`Self::section`] is the finished half-profile when a caller stored one.

diameter_mode.description: Post hint only. Toolpath X is still a radius.

section.description: Finished half-profile, `(z, radius)`, front to back.

Vec3.description: A vector in millimetres, or a unitless direction.
